description: This file implements a JPEG encoder class for Android, including functions for configuration, buffer management, encoding, and EXIF data creation, specifically for Samsung devices.

classes.name: JpegEncoder
classes.description: A class providing JPEG encoding functionalities, including configuration, buffer handling, encoding, and EXIF data embedding.

methods.name: JpegEncoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the JPEG encoder, setting up device and memory mappings.

methods.name: ~JpegEncoder
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources and closing device.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Configures encoder parameters such as width, height, quality, format, and thumbnail size.

methods.name: getInBuf
methods.description: Retrieves input buffer for image data.

methods.name: getOutBuf
methods.description: Retrieves output buffer containing encoded JPEG data.

methods.name: getThumbInBuf
methods.description: Retrieves input buffer for thumbnail data.

methods.name: getThumbOutBuf
methods.description: Retrieves output buffer containing encoded thumbnail.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Performs JPEG encoding, optionally embedding EXIF data.

methods.name: encodeThumbImg
methods.description: Encodes thumbnail image, scaling if necessary.

methods.name: makeExif
methods.description: Creates EXIF metadata for JPEG images, including GPS and thumbnail info.

methods.name: checkMcu
methods.description: Checks and adjusts image size to match MCU block requirements based on sampling mode.

methods.name: pad
methods.description: Pads image data to meet MCU size requirements.

methods.name: scaleDownYuv422
methods.description: Scales down YUV422 image data for thumbnail creation.

methods.name: writeExifIfd
methods.description: Helper functions to write EXIF IFD entries with different data types.
